scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah...
Here it is!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊...
找到了！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome to the Airship~
If you have questions or
need any assistance, please
don't hesitate to ask me or
any one of the other crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
欢迎来到飞空艇~
如果您有任何问题
或需要协助，请随时
向我或其他船员询问。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
A few days ago, a customer
from Einbroch left this on the
Airship. He called and let us
know that he can't come back
to get it, but he is staying
over at the Einbroch Hotel.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
几天前，一位来自
艾音布罗克的顾客
把东西落在了飞空艇上。
他打电话告诉我们，
他无法回来取，
但他住在艾音布罗克酒店。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know it's a strange
favor to ask, but would
you deliver this to Defru
Ark at the Einbroch Hotel?
Of course, I'll repay you
upon your return.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我知道这个请求
有点奇怪，但您能
把这个送到艾音布罗克酒店
的Defru Ark那里吗？
当然，您回来时
我会报答您的。

scripts.text: ^3355FFKain Himere has given you a small box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF凯恩·希梅尔给了您一个小盒子。^000000

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 关于飞空艇...

scripts.text: Leave a Comment
scripts.translation: 留下评论

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Is this your first time flying?
I understand if you feel nervous. Before I worked here, I used to feel the same way. Still, this
Airship is pretty amazing. It's incredible what science can do...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
这是您第一次坐飞机吗？
我理解您可能会感到紧张。在我来这里工作之前，我也会有同样的感觉。不过，这架飞空艇真的很惊人。科学的力量真是不可思议...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You want to hear more
about the Airship? Hmm,
there's not too much that
I know, but let me see...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您想多了解一些
关于飞空艇的事吗？嗯，
我知道的并不多，
不过让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I hear from the scholars
who developed the Airship
technology that just a little
piece of the heart of Ymir
generates the power for
this ship to fly. Incredible...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我听说，开发飞空艇技术的
学者们说，只需要
尤米尔心脏的一小部分，
就能产生让这艘船
飞行的动力。太不可思议了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You know, scientific research
has made living easier and more
comfortable in the Schwarzwald
Republic, much in the way magic
research has changed life in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
你知道吗，科学研究
让修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
的生活变得更加便捷和舒适，
就像魔法研究改变了
卢恩·米德加兹王国的生活一样。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Well, it's rumored that this
really big corporation runs
this Airship. Supposedly,
they've got their hands in
all sorts of enterprises.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
嗯，据说有一家
非常大的公司
在运营这架飞空艇。
据说他们涉足
各种各样的企业。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since the Airships are our
form of national transportation,
the higher-ups must be making
a ton of money. It's pretty crazy.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
既然飞空艇是我们
国家的主要交通工具，
高层肯定赚了很多钱。
真是挺疯狂的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You wish to leave
a comment about our
service? Tell me your
message and I'll report
it to the higher ups.
To cancel, press '0'.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您想对我们的服务
留下评论吗？请告诉我
您的留言，我会向
上级汇报。
若要取消，请按'0'。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
K-Kafra...?
Hmm, maybe I better
not send this up after all...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
卡...卡普拉...？
嗯，也许我最好
还是别把这个
传上去了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, well, if you have any
helpful criticism about our
service, feel free to leave
me a comment at any time.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊，好吧，如果您
对我们的服务有任何
建设性的批评，
请随时给我留言。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Hmmmm...
I see. Well, I'll
send your message
to my superiors as
soon as possible.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
嗯...
我明白了。我会
尽快将您的留言
转达给我的上级。
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you?
If you don't mind me
asking, where are you
headed this time?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，您好吗？
如果不介意的话，
请问您这次
要去哪里？

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 关于飞空艇...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You must really want to know all about the Airship, don't you? I'm sorry, but I don't know much more than what I've already told you.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您一定非常想了解飞空艇的一切，对吧？很抱歉，除了我已经告诉您的，我并不知道更多了。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I guess if you'd want to know more, you should study to become a Sage in Juno and do your own Airship research...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我想，如果您想了解更多，应该去朱诺学习成为贤者，并亲自进行飞空艇的研究...

scripts.text: What the hell...?
scripts.translation: 这到底是怎么回事...？

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I-I'm sorry...
That was so
unprofessional.
H-have a safe trip
and th-thank you for
using the Airship! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
对...对不起...
那样做太不
专业了。
祝...祝您旅途
平安，谢...谢谢您
乘坐飞空艇！ ^333333*抽泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I'm sorry, but it's
a long story. Plus,
you wouldn't understand...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
很抱歉，这说来话长。
而且，您也
不会明白的...

scripts.text: I have time for a long story.
scripts.translation: 我有时间听长故事。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Alright, I might as well get
this off my chest. I guess it
all started when I was a young
man living in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
好吧，我干脆
把心里话说出来吧。我想
一切都要从我年轻时
住在艾音贝赫说起。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Those days, I was pretty hot
headed and short tempered,
but working as a miner used to
always bring me a sense of peace. Staking my life with my friends, mining pick in hand. Yeah...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
那时候，我脾气很
暴躁，容易发火，
但从事矿工工作总
能让我感到平静。和朋友们
一起拼上性命，手持矿镐。是啊...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It might have been dangerous,
but it was good, hard and honest work. You know, the mines that connected to the Einbech lode
used to be everything to our little town. But then, things changed...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
虽然可能很危险，
但那是好的、辛苦且
诚实的工作。您知道，连接
艾音贝赫矿脉的矿坑
曾是我们小镇的一切。但后来，情况变了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
The factories started popping
up and all the ores were moved
to where the smokestacks never
stopped churning. More miners
started working in the factories and the mines became lonelier...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
工厂开始拔地而起，
所有的矿石都被运往
烟囱从未停止冒烟的地方。更多的矿工
开始在工厂工作，矿坑变得
更加寂寞...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
But I loved working on the
land so much, I kept at it
until the accident happened.
Now I can't use my right arm
the way I used to, so I had to
quit my job as a miner...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
但我太热爱在
大地上工作了，所以我
坚持了下来，直到
事故发生。现在我
无法像以前那样使用
右臂，所以我不得不
辞去矿工的工作...

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Yeah...
I was really devastated
when it happened. Those
were probably the worst
years of my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
是啊...
发生那件事时，我
真的非常痛苦。那
大概是我人生中
最糟糕的几年。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I couldn't think about
life without mining and
I just lost all enthusiasm
for life. I developed a drinking problem and started shutting out my family. I was so stupid...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我无法想象
没有挖矿的生活，
我完全失去了
对生活的热情。我染上了
酗酒的问题，并开始
疏远家人。我太愚蠢了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I still can't believe how
supportive my wife was during
those days. Even when I was at
my lowest, she tried to sooth my sorrow and even took on a job
to support me and our daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我至今仍无法相信
我的妻子在那段日子里
是多么支持我。即使在我
最落魄的时候，她试图
抚慰我的悲伤，甚至
找了一份工作来
养活我和女儿。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 It was only after she
died that I realized how much
she must have suffered. To make
matters worse, I had to leave my daughter behind with a neighbor
while I searched for work...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
^666666*抽泣*^000000 直到她
去世后，我才意识到
她一定承受了多大的痛苦。更糟糕的是，我不得不
把女儿留在邻居那里，
而我四处寻找工作...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I spent years wandering
from town to town, living
a pretty wild life until I could pick myself up again. And finally, I became an Airship crewman.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我花了几年时间
从一个城镇流浪到另一个城镇，
过着相当放荡的生活，
直到我重新振作起来。最后，我
成为了飞空艇的船员。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It's been twenty years
since I've lost my family.
My daughter is somewhere
out there, but I can't even
remember her name...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
距离我失去家人
已经二十年了。
我的女儿在
某个地方，但我甚至
记不起她的名字...

scripts.text: Have you tried looking for her?
scripts.translation: 你试过找她吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I tried going to the house
where my neighbor had lived,
but they moved out years ago.
I really have no clue where she
could be. But I don't deserve to see her. I was a horrible father!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我试着去
我邻居住过的房子，
但他们几年前就搬走了。
我真的不知道她
在哪里。但我不配
见她。我是个糟糕的父亲！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 I'm sorry you
had to hear all of that,
but I really appreciate that
you've listened to me. Now
tell me, where are you headed?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
^666666*抽泣*^000000 很抱歉让您
听了这些，
但我真的很感激
您愿意听我倾诉。现在
告诉我，您要去哪里？

scripts.text: Einbroch
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Perfect...!
If you don't mind,
would you do a favor
for me? First, let me
find that package...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
太好了...！
如果不介意的话，
能帮我个忙吗？
首先，让我找找那个包裹...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Juno.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, I see...
There was something
I needed sent to Einbroch.
Anyway, have a good trip.
Oh, and thanks for listening.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊，是吗...
我本来有东西要寄到艾音布罗克。
总之，祝你旅途愉快。
哦，还有，谢谢你愿意听我倾诉。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh hello!
Things are a little
hectic right now, but
did you delive-- Oh!
Wait, excuse me! Sir--!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，你好！
现在有点忙，
你是来送...哦！
等等，失礼了！先生--！

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain seems too
busy to speak to
you right now...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF凯恩似乎太忙了，
现在没法和您对话...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome back to the Airship. So did you deliver that little box safely?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
欢迎回到飞空艇。那个小箱子你安全送出去了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, unfortunately. He was away when I got there. Let me give this box back to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，很遗憾。我到的时候他不在。让我把这个箱子还给您。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh...
What should I do now? Oh well, sorry for putting you through so much trouble.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦...
现在该怎么办呢？算了，抱歉给你添了这么多麻烦。

scripts.text: Casually mention Miner's Song
scripts.translation: 随意提及矿工之歌

scripts.text: Suavely mention Tarsha
scripts.translation: 优雅地提及塔莎

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While we're on the topic
of boxes and deliveries,
have you ever heard of
the ''Miner's Song?''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然提到了箱子和快递，
你听说过''矿工之歌''吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
''Miner's Song...''
I miss singing that
while working the mines.
I used to sing it all the time
when I was younger, actually.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
''矿工之歌...''
我怀念在矿里工作时
唱那首歌的日子。
其实我小时候经常唱。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I think I sang it so
much, I even got my little
daughter to sing it with me~
(But what was her name?!)
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我想我唱得太多，
连我的小女儿都跟着我唱了~
（但她叫什么名字来着？！）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Cough cough*
*Cou--TARSHA--Cough*^000000

[Kain Himere]
What the...?
Wait. T-Tarsha...
Why does it feel like that
name means something?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
什么...？
等等。塔--塔莎...
为什么这个名字
听起来很熟悉？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know...
I met a little girl in Einbroch
who was singing the ''Miner's
Song.'' It seems her mother
Tarsha had taught it to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗...
我在艾音布罗克遇到一个小女孩，
她在唱''矿工之歌''。
看来是她的母亲塔莎教给她的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Interesting. But usually,
only miners would know 
that song. Does this have
anything to do with me?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
有意思。但通常，
只有矿工才会知道
那首歌。这和我
有什么关系吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this little girl's mother, Tarsha, learned the song from
her father who might have been
a miner. But he mysteriously
disappeared years ago...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那个小女孩的母亲塔莎，
是从她父亲那里学会这首歌的，
他可能是一名矿工。但他几年前
神秘地失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Poor girl...!
Her father just
left her?! Why,
she's just like...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
可怜的孩子...！
她父亲竟然
丢下她走了？天哪，
她简直就像...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Wait...
Sweet Christ...
The miner who taught
Tarsha that song might
have been... ^0000FFme^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
等等...
天哪...
教塔莎那首歌的矿工，
也许就是... ^0000FF我^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, for now, we can't
be too sure. Do you have
anything that might prove
you're Tarsha's father?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，目前我们还不能确定。
你有什么能证明
你是塔莎父亲的证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ehhmmm...
Before I left own, I buried
some of my stuff underneath
a tree in Einbech. I can't exactly remember where, but my wife's
journal should be there.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
呃...
在我离开之前，我把一些东西
埋在了艾音贝赫的一棵树下。
我不太记得具体位置了，
但我妻子的日记应该在那里。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since my wife kept track
of everything in her journal,
she should have written enough
about our daughter for us to know whether or not this Tarsha could be my long lost daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
因为我妻子把一切都记录在日记里，
她应该写了很多关于女儿的事，
足以让我们判断这个塔莎
是否真的是我失散多年的女儿。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Now, I can't really leave
the Airship, so would you help
me by finding that journal and
seeing if Tarsha is really related to me somehow? I'd be grateful
if you could do that for me...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
现在，我实在无法离开飞空艇，
所以你能帮我找到那本日记，
看看塔莎是否真的与我有关吗？
如果你能帮我这个忙，我将感激不尽...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Would you find my wife's
journal and see if Tarsha
is really my daughter? The
journal should be buried
underneath a tree in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
你能找到我妻子的日记，
看看塔莎是否真的是我的女儿吗？
日记应该埋在艾音贝赫的一棵树下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou better fulfill Kain's
request by finding his wife's
journal and confronting Tarsha
before you speak to him again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好先找到他妻子的日记，
并去见见塔莎，
然后再回来找凯恩对话。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give his wife's
journal to Kain and tell
him that you learn that Tarsha
is really his daughter and that
she is happily married and is
an inventor in Einbroch.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把妻子的日记交给凯恩，
并告诉他你得知塔莎
真的是他的女儿，
她已婚且生活幸福，
现在是艾音布罗克的一名发明家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain's eyes well
with tears and his
entire body trembles
with unrestrainable joy.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF凯恩热泪盈眶，
全身因无法抑制的喜悦
而颤抖着。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
She must have
had a hard time...
But she doesn't
hate me at all.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
她一定过得很辛苦...
但她一点也不恨我。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Rashelle?
Can you see me?
Can I really be this
happy? I'm so sorry,
my love... ^666666*Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
拉谢尔？
你能看到我吗？
我真的可以这么幸福吗？
对不起，我的爱人... ^666666*啜泣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Thank you for all of
your help, youngster.
And please, take this
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
谢谢你所有的帮助，年轻人。
请收下这个，
作为我的一点心意。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know this isn't
much, but please
understand that it's
all I have to give you.
God bless you for all
you've done for me~
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我知道这不算什么，
但请理解，
这是我唯一能给你的了。
上帝保佑你，
谢谢你为我所做的一切~

scripts.text:
^3355FFHmmm...
It would be better
if you approached
Kain with the Doodled
Letter that you received.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
如果你带着收到的涂鸦信件
去找凯恩，情况可能会更好。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you
lately, my friend?
I've been doing great,
especially since you've
helped me find my daughter.
Enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，最近怎么样，我的朋友？
我过得很好，
尤其是你帮我找到了女儿之后。
旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?
^3355FFNo one's here!^000000

[{0}]
This must be the room...
But where the hell is he?
I can't just leave this stuff
here if he won't come back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这应该是他的房间...
但他到底在哪里？
如果他不会回来，
我不能把这些东西留在这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh well...
I guess I can
just give this
back to Kain
on the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了...
我想我可以把这些东西
带回飞空艇还给凯恩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While I'm in Einbroch,
I may as well take a look
around here and see if I can
find anything interesting. Still, I can't help but think of Kain
Himere's long lost daughter...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然我在艾音布罗克，
不妨四处看看，
找找有没有什么有趣的东西。
不过，我还是忍不住想起
凯恩·希梅尔失散多年的女儿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Maybe...
Just maybe...
I can find some
sort of clue about
where she is. She might
even live here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也许...
只是也许...
我能找到一些关于
她下落的线索。
她甚至可能就住在
艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think I'll do that.
Maybe even right this
minute. Treat it like
sort of quest or something.
Yeah, that could work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想我会这么做。
也许就从现在开始。
把它当成某种任务吧。
嗯，这样应该可以。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
让我们开始工作吧，
无所畏惧的同志们~！
加油！没有什么能
阻挡我们，伙计们~！

scripts.text: Hello!
scripts.translation: 你好！

scripts.text: What are you singing?
scripts.translation: 你在唱什么歌？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
让我们开始工作吧，
无所畏惧的同志们~！
加油！没有什么能
阻挡我们，伙计们~！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I like this song lots!
Especially when I yell out
''comrades!'' COMRADES!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
我很喜欢这首歌！
尤其是当我大声喊出
“同志们！”的时候。同志们！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
This...?
It's the ''Miner's Song!''
My mommy taught it to me
and she sings it a lot. Daddy
says it's too noisy, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
这个...？
这是《矿工之歌》！
是我妈妈教我的，
她经常唱。不过爸爸
说太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Mmm, when my mommy sings
this song, sometimes she looks
a little sad. Jus' today she sang it a little and looked like she was gonna cry. ^666666*Gasp!*^000000 Wait, do you
think maybe Mommy's sick?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
嗯，当妈妈唱这首歌时，
她有时候看起来有点难过。
今天她唱了一小段，
看起来快要哭了。^666666*倒吸一口凉气！*^000000 等等，
你觉得妈妈是不是生病了？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Oh no, oh no...
Hey, will you go see
if my mommy's okay for me?
Please? Our house is behind
the Hotel, so tell me if she's
not feeling good, promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
天哪，天哪...
嘿，你能去看看
我妈妈没事吗？
拜托了？我们家在
旅馆后面，如果她
感觉不舒服，请告诉我，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Our house is right
behind of the Hotel.
Will you go there and
see my mommy for me,
please? I'm worried...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
我们家就在
旅馆后面。
你能去那里
看看我妈妈吗？
拜托了？我很担心...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Hey! I have something
to give you, but you have
tooooo much stuff! Hey,
come back later so I can
give it to you, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
嘿！我有东西
要给你，但是你的
东西太多了！嘿，
请稍后再来，这样我
才能给你，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
You saw my grandpa?
You're his friend, right?
A-are you gonna see
him later? 'Cuz... cuz...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
你见过我爷爷吗？
你是他的朋友，对吧？
你...你稍后会去
见他吗？因为...因为...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I made this for him.
I don't know how to write,
but I made Grampa a letter
as best as I can. Will you
promise to give this to him
for me, pleeeeeease?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
我给他做了这个。
我不会写字，
但我尽力给爷爷
写了一封信。你能
答应把这封信
交给他吗？拜托了？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElle put a big
doodled message
into your hands.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾勒把一封
大大的涂鸦信件
塞进了你的手里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
You're very kind,
adventurer. There
should be more people
in the world like you.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你真是个好心人，
冒险者。世界上应该
有更多像你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Are you sure
that you can find
Tarsha's father? Oh,
you must be a godsend!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你确定你能找到
塔尔莎的父亲吗？哦，
你真是帮了大忙！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I'm so happy
for my wife. I....
I don't know how
I can thank you...
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
我为我的妻子感到
高兴。我...
我不知道该怎么
感谢你...

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Hmm...
Can we talk later?
I'm pretty busy trying
to fix this thing at
the moment.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
嗯...
我们稍后再谈好吗？
我现在正忙着
修理这个东西。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Although most of these
contraptions aren't worth
showing off, we've put a lot
of work in inventing these
machines. So, of course,
they give us pride~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
虽然这些发明
大多不值得炫耀，
但我们花了很多心思
去发明这些机器。
所以，当然，
它们让我们感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Maybe all these little
projects might not be
that impressive, but I like
to think of them as stepping
stones to future achievements.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
也许这些小小的
项目并不那么令人印象深刻，
但我喜欢把它们看作
通往未来成就的
垫脚石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, ma'am,
but you have a scar
on your shoulder. Is
that from an accident?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，女士，
您肩膀上有一道伤疤。
那是意外造成的吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, that's an old
injury that happened
years ago. I suppose
I was quite the trouble
maker to the people
who raised me...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，那是多年前
留下的旧伤。我想，
对于抚养我长大的人来说，
我大概是个很让人头疼的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
You see, I lost my parents
when I was very young. It
was only later when I realized
I was raised by foster parents.
I learned that my real mother
died a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
你看，我很小的时候
就失去了父母。后来我才意识到，
我是被养父母抚养长大的。
我得知我的亲生母亲
早已去世...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
As for my father, no
one knows if he's dead
or alive. I tried my best
to my foster parents happy,
but I ended up being too rebellious and giving them grief.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
至于我的父亲，
没人知道他是否还活着。
我尽力想让养父母开心，
但我最终变得太叛逆，
给他们惹了不少麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I finally left home and
studied mechanics. I met
my husband in school and
it was the greatest thing that
ever happened to me~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
最后我离开了家，
去学习了机匠技术。我在学校里
遇到了我的丈夫，
那是我人生中发生过的
最美好的事情~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, I heard
your daughter singing
some sort of Miner's Song.
Did you teach her that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
顺便问一下，我听说
您的女儿在唱
某种矿工之歌。
是您教她的吗？

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I don't understand
why little Elle likes
such a rowdy, man song.
This is all your fault, Tarsha!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
我不明白为什么
小艾勒喜欢
这么粗犷的男性歌曲。
这都是你的错，塔尔莎！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~hohohoho~
I was too young to
remember it clearly,
but I'm sure my real
father loved that song.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦~呵呵呵~
我当时太小了，
记忆不太清晰，
但我确信我的亲生父亲
很喜欢那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I barely recall that
he used to sing it while
cleaning our old house.
Yes, I don't remember what
he looked like, but he must
have been a miner at one time.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我依稀记得
他以前打扫我们旧房子时
会哼唱这首歌。
是的，我不记得他长什么样，
但他一定曾经是一名矿工。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A miner...?
(Wait, that crewman,
Kain Himere! He was
a miner who lost his
daughter! Just maybe...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
矿工...？
（等等，那个船员，
凯恩·希梅尔！他是一名
失去了女儿的矿工！也许...）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...!
Tarsha...
Your father
may still be alive!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...！
塔尔莎...
您的父亲
可能还活着！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...What?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
...什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've got to go check
something now, but
hopefully I'll be back
soon with good news!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在得去确认
一些事情，但
希望很快就能带着
好消息回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tarsha, I know someone
who might be your father!
Just wait for me and hopefully
I'll bring back good news soon!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔尔莎，我认识一个人，
他可能是您的父亲！
请等我一下，希望我很快
就能带回好消息！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, welcome back~
So were you able to
bring back good news?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，欢迎回来~
那么，您能带回
好消息吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, yes.
Speaking of which,
allow me to... check
something first...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，当然。
说到这个，
请允许我...先检查
一下...

scripts.text: Check her neck.
scripts.translation: 检查她的脖子。

scripts.text: Check her hands.
scripts.translation: 检查她的手。

scripts.text: Check her legs.
scripts.translation: 检查她的腿。

scripts.text: Check her forehead.
scripts.translation: 检查她的额头。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found
a burn mark on
her hand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在她的手上
发现了一道烧伤痕迹。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it!
Tarsha, your
father's name is
Kain Himere and he's
working on the Airship
as one of the crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是它！
塔尔莎，你父亲的名字
是凯恩·希梅尔，他正在
飞空艇上担任船员之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He misses you
a lot and hopes
that you can forgive
him... Someday.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他非常想念你，
希望你能原谅他...
总有一天。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Are...
Are you serious?
My father's alive!
Oh thank god! Thank
you so much, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
你...你是认真的吗？
我父亲还活着！
感谢上帝！太感谢你了，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...........
So that means, my
real name would be
^3131FFTarsha Himere Cherno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
...........
那么也就是说，我的
真名应该是
^3131FF塔尔莎·希梅尔·切尔诺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, you're a godsend!
I'll never forget what you've
done for me! I must repay
you somehow! But all I know
is mechanical engineering...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哎呀，你真是帮了大忙！
我永远不会忘记你为我做的一切！
我一定要报答你！但我懂的
只有机械工程...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I know~
If you have any
^3131FFbroken equipment^000000,
I can fix it with this
Expert Repairman. It's
one of our best inventions!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，我知道了~
如果你有任何
^3131FF损坏的装备^000000，
我可以用这个
专业修理工来修理它。这是
我们最好的发明之一！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I must go and see
my real father soon!
I've missed him for years!
Thank you again for all
you've done for my family~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我必须尽快去见
我真正的父亲！
我已经好几年没见他了！
再次感谢你对我们
全家所做的一切~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, and before you
go, would you go see
Elle again? She wanted to
talk to you for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，在你走之前，
你能再去见艾勒一次吗？
她似乎想和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I've been feeling great
after all you've done for
us. Once again, I'd like to
thank you, kind adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
在你为我们做了这么多之后，
我感觉好多了。再次，
我想谢谢你，善良的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I'm sorry, but
we're pretty busy.
Please excuse us~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
抱歉，但我们
现在很忙。
请原谅我们~

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Honey...
I think there's
a critical structural
problem with the joint.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
亲爱的...
我觉得连接处
有严重的结构问题。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
They must not
be connected right.
Maybe if we... Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
它们肯定没有
连接好。
也许如果我们...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Well, let's call
it a day and finish
this tomorrow, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
好了，今天就
到此为止，明天
再完成它，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~
I didn't know we
had a guest. Hello,
how are you doing?
Are you interested in
any of our inventions?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦~
我不知道我们有
客人。你好，
你最近怎么样？
你对我们的发明
感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Your daughter asked me to visit you.
scripts.translation: 你女儿让我来拜访你。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Oh yes, my wife are
I are keeping ourselves
busy by conducting research.
We're trying to invent new
things for better living.
It's what we do...
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
是的，我和妻子正忙着做研究。
我们试图发明一些能让生活变得更好的新东西。
这就是我们的工作...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Hahaha, Elle?
Why would our
daughter send
you to visit us?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哈哈，艾勒？
她为什么会派你
来拜访我们呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, uh...
She wanted me to
check if her mom
was sick or sad
...Or something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那个...
她让我来看看
她妈妈是不是生病了，
或者心情不好
...之类的？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh my god...!
What is she thinking?
I apologize for troubling
you over this kind of silly
mistake, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
天哪...！
她在想什么呢？
很抱歉让您为这种
愚蠢的误会
感到困扰，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
But wait, darling.
I agree that sometimes
you look like the loneliest
person in the world, gazing
out that window with those
impossibly wistful eyes.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
但是等等，亲爱的。
我承认，有时候
你看起来像是世界上最孤独的人，
凝视着窗外，
用那双充满渴望的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I must be
making my family
very anxious. But
don't you worry, love.
I'm very happy with
you and Elle.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，我一定是
让家人很担心了。
但别担心，亲爱的。
和你和艾勒在一起，
我很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
And...
Kind adventurer,
may I ask your name?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
还有...
善良的冒险者，
我可以问一下您的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am called,
{1}.

[Tarsha Cherno]
{0},
I appreciate your
concern for us. Would
you stay for a cup of tea?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
{0}，
感谢您的关心。
您愿意留下来喝杯茶吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Now, please pardon the
mess. My husband and I are
mechanical engineers focused
on creating machines that would
reduce the risk of mining ores.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
请原谅这里的凌乱。
我和丈夫是机械工程师，
专注于制造能
降低采矿风险的机器。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Since we work at home, we
can't avoid having machine
parts lying here and there
sometimes. In any case, we're
hoping we create a machine that could make miners' lives safer...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
因为我们在家里工作，
难免会有机器零件
散落各处。总之，
我们希望制造出
能让矿工生活更安全的机器...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
So that's why
there's so many
interesting things
in your house...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...
原来这就是为什么
你家里有这么多
有趣的东西...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou begin to
take a look around
the Cherno household.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你开始
四处看看
切尔诺家的情况。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's...
It's a really
strange looking
machine. Does it
even do anything?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是...
一台看起来很奇怪的
机器。它甚至
能做什么吗？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a mirror.
So, of course the
first thing you'll
see is yourself.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一面镜子。
所以，你首先
看到的当然是
你自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh wow...
I look pretty good.
No wait. Really, really
good. So this must be
why I get such great
service at restaurants...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
我看起来很不错。
不，等等。真的，
非常非常好看。这一定
就是为什么我在餐厅
能得到这么好的服务...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Man...
I didn't know
I was so good
looking! Ooh yah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...
我都不知道
自己这么帅！
哦耶~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
So that's why the
ladies keep looking
at me. I'm a walking
free gun show!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
原来这就是为什么
女士们总是盯着我看。
我简直就是一座
行走的免费枪展！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's a shame I can't job
change to Male Model.
Clearly, I'd be like, Job
Level 87 or something.
Man, I'm beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惜我不能转职
成男模。
显然，我会是
87级左右的职业。
天哪，我真美...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is my reflection?!
No one can be this good
looking, not without special
effects! I mean, it's not
fair to everyone else...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是我的倒影吗？！
没有人能长得这么好看，
除非有特效！我是说，
这对其他人来说
不公平...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh. Wow.
I never realized...
Everything is in
perfect proportion!
No wonder people
want to party with me~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦。哇。
我从来没意识到...
我的比例竟然如此完美！
难怪大家都想和我组队~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my gosh~
How can I look this
good without any makeup?
I-It isn't fair to all the other
girls... Wow, is this really me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪~
我明明没化妆，
怎么能这么好看？
这...这对其他女生来说不公平...哇，这真的是我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Am I going crazy?
Is that girl in the
mirror really me...?
How did I not realize
how gorgeous I look?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我疯了吗？
镜子里那个女孩
真的是我吗...？
我怎么会没发现自己
长得这么迷人呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
What did you do with
this mirror? Because I'm
looking at my reflection
and I can't seem to find
any flaws with my figure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...
你对这面镜子做了什么？
因为我看着我的倒影，
完全找不到我身材的缺点...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Actually...
That's not one
of our inventions.
It's just a normal mirror...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
其实...
那并不是
我们的发明。
它只是一面普通的镜子...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well now...!
Are you sure?
Because my face looks
freakin' immaculate! And
it's like, I'm almost too sexy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀...！
你确定吗？
因为我的脸看起来
简直完美无瑕！而且
我简直性感得过头了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter enjoying that
little epiphany, you
see a reflection of
Tarsha's neck as you
set the mirror back down.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在享受完这小小的顿悟后，
当你把镜子放回去时，
你看到了塔尔莎脖子的倒影。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you take a closer
look, you find that there's
a strange mark around her
neck. What ever could it mean?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你凑近细看时，
发现她脖子上有一个奇怪的印记。
那究竟意味着什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou crouch down
under the tree and
begin digging into
the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你蹲在树下，
开始挖掘地面。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355ffUnfortunately,
you weren't able
to find anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355ff很遗憾，
你什么也没找到。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have found a journal
among some other articles
that have been buried by Kain.
You open the journal and begin
to read what's written inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在被凯恩埋藏的物品中
找到了一本日记。
你打开日记，开始阅读里面的内容。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThat was the last page of the journal. You picked it up so that you can bring it over to ^3131FFTarsha.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那是日记的最后一页。你把它拿起来，
准备带给^3131FF塔尔莎。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou open
the journal
and begin to read...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你打开
日记
开始阅读...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I'm sooo happy
to be with Kain.
He's such an honest,
sincere man, even if
he is quiet sometimes.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363能和凯恩在一起，
我真的太开心了。
他是个诚实、
真诚的男人，虽然
有时候有点沉默。

scripts.text:
^856363Although he's a very
good husband to me,
I'm not so good at being
a housewife. But I'll do
my very best for us both.
scripts.translation:
^856363虽然他是我的好丈夫，
但我并不擅长做家庭主妇。不过我会
为我们俩尽我最大的努力。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I fell asleep while
fixing dinner and burned
all the food. How can I be
so careless? But Kain ate
every bite, even if he had
to pretend that he liked it.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363我在做晚饭时睡着了，
把食物全烧焦了。我怎么会
这么粗心？但凯恩还是
把每一口都吃光了，即使他
不得不假装自己喜欢。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I will be having
a child soon! I'm so happy,
but I'm also a little worried
sometimes. Kain is all smiles
though, and he gives me relief.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凯恩和我很快
就要有孩子了！我很开心，
但有时候也有点担心。不过凯恩
总是面带微笑，
让我感到安心。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363More people have been
leaving the mines to work
for the new factories, many
of them Kain's friends. I think
Kain's pride was pretty hurt.
I wonder how I can help him?^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363越来越多的人
离开矿山去新工厂工作，
其中很多是凯恩的朋友。我想
凯恩的自尊心受挫了。
我该怎么帮他呢？^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I are now the
proud parents of a beautiful
baby girl. We named her ^000000Tarsha^856363
and she has her father's eyes.
I'm going to be the best mother
that I can possibly be for her.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凯恩和我现在成为了
一个漂亮女婴的父母。
我们给她取名^000000塔尔莎^856363
她有着像父亲一样的眼睛。
我要做我能做到的
最好的母亲。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha called me
''Mommy'' for the first
time! It's a miracle!
I want nothing else in
the world but for her to
be happy and healthy.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363塔尔莎第一次
叫我''妈妈''了！
这是奇迹！
我别无他求，
只希望她能快乐健康。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain got into an accident
at the mine. While they were
digging ores, toxic gas was
released somehow. It wasn't
lethal, but Kain's arm has
been partly paralyzed...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凯恩在矿场出了事故。
他们在挖掘矿石时，不知怎的
泄漏了有毒瓦斯。虽然不致命，
但凯恩的手臂部分瘫痪了...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363When the doctor said that
it may even affect his memories
later, he became so depressed.
I tried to make him feel better
by making his favorite soup.
He smiled, but I could tell...^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363当医生说这甚至可能
影响他的记忆时，他变得非常沮丧。
我试着做他最喜欢的汤
让他心情好点。他笑了，
但我看得出来...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363I could tell he's
not alright with this.
I hope he feels better
soon. His despair is
at least as great as his
passion for his job.^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363我能感觉到
他对此并不满意。
希望他早日康复。
他的绝望至少和他
对工作的热情一样强烈。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain's drinking is
getting worse. He comes
home too often screaming
and yelling. There's too
much anger in him and he's
not the same anymore...
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凯恩的酗酒越来越严重了。
他回家时经常大喊大叫。
他充满了愤怒，
已经不再是以前那个他了...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha got her hand
scalded from boiling
water while playing in
the kitchen. Although she
was treated, she'll always
have that ^000000burn mark^856363.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363塔尔莎在厨房玩耍时，
被开水烫伤了手。虽然治疗了，
但她手上永远会留下^000000烧伤疤痕^856363。^000000

scripts.text:
^856363After we got home from
the doctor's, Tarsha laughed
and played with her doll as if
nothing ever happened. But for
some reason, I couldn't stop
myself from crying...^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363从医生那里回家后，
塔尔莎笑着玩她的娃娃，
好像什么都没发生过一样。
但不知为何，
我忍不住哭了起来...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain comes home less
nowadays. I've had to
start working in the store
after we spent all of our
savings. It's tough working
and taking care of the family.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363最近凯恩回家的次数变少了。
我们用光了积蓄，
所以我不得不在店里工作。
一边工作一边照顾家庭，
真的很辛苦。

scripts.text:
^856363Still, it's all worth
it to see Tarsha's smile.
But I can never stop worrying
about my poor, dear Kain...
scripts.translation:
^856363不过，看到塔尔莎的笑容，
一切都值得了。
但我总是无法停止
为我可怜又亲爱的凯恩担心...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Everyday, I feel weaker
and weaker, as if I die
just a little more each day.
I wanted to tell Kain about
what the doctor said, but he's
not ready for this news yet...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363每一天，我都感觉更虚弱，
仿佛每天都在一点点死去。
我想告诉凯恩医生说的话，
但他还没准备好接受这个消息...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363Lately, Tarsha cries
a lot. My poor baby loves
her father, but he's always
so distant. But sometimes,
I see him sadly smile for
Tarsha, if only for a moment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363最近，塔尔莎经常哭。
我可怜的孩子爱她的父亲，
但他总是那么疏远。但有时候，
我会看到他为了塔尔莎
悲伤地微笑，哪怕只是一瞬间。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the
^FF0000Expert Repairman^000000?!
It looks like it
needs repairs itself...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这就是
^FF0000专家修理工^000000？！
看起来它自己
都需要修理了...
